sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13973
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1727 of 2024

Applicant :- Rajnish Pandey Alias Manish Pandey
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Sectt. U.P. Lko.

And 3 Othe
Counsel for Applicant :- Raja Babu Gupta

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and Sri Firoz Ahmad Khan, who has filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the informant and perused the record.
The Vakalatnama is taken on record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.207 of 2022, under Sections 323, 504, 506,
376-D IPC, Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Section 3(1)ba, 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act, Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Gonda.
3. It has been informed that the co-accused Pawan Pandey and Rajnish Pandey have been enlarged on bail.
The bail orders are on record as Annexures 13 and 14 to the bail application.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

1

5. Considering the fact that the allegations against the applicant are similar to the co-accused who have been enlarged on bail coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 04.06.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Rajnish Pandey alias Manish Pandey be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.2.2024 akverma  Rajnish Pandey Alias Manish Pandey vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...
